selection_data: 2021-2024 Stage-1 characterization; 2025 Stage-1 divergence sanity check only
label: 1-second OHLC research simulation; not NT-native executable validation
filter_rationale: 120s is the natural rounded discovery median vicinity for time-to-1ATR (137s; 2025 descriptive sanity check 139s); remaining values are the prompt's single candidate structure and were not searched
weakness_trigger: first valid W4 crossing from below the frozen absolute threshold while the established filter is true
entry: fade prevailing regime at explicit next available 1s bar open after score availability (observation_time + 1s)
stop_anchor: entry fill price using causal ATR carried on the W4 checkpoint
stop_fill: trigger price on touch; entry/open gap through stop fills at bar open
exit: hold through first aligning flip; exit at explicit next available 1s open after next flip against countertrade
same_bar_rule: scheduled flip exit fills at its decision-boundary open before that bar's intrabar range; stop is evaluated on all earlier bars including entry bar
overlap_rule: one position at a time; candidate entry decisions strictly before the current position exit fill are skipped
